The transaction is expected to close “in the first half of 2027,” subject to regulatory approval\. # AEVEX to Acquire BlackSea in $650M Autonomous Defense Deal AEVEX has agreed to acquire BlackSea Technologies in a deal worth up to $650 million, expanding its autonomous systems portfolio across air, surface, and subsea domains\. The transaction, expected to be finalized in September, includes about $250 million in cash, $350 million in AEVEX Class A shares, and up to $50 million in performance-based earnout payments\. The combined company will offer platforms spanning Groups I-V unmanned aircraft, unmanned surface vessels, unmanned underwater vehicles, contested logistics systems, and AI-enabled mission software\. AEVEX said it plans to integrate its CompassX autonomy ecosystem into selected BlackSea maritime platforms, enabling coordinated operations across air and maritime domains while supporting navigation in GPS-denied environments\. # Joby Aviation Buys Resonant Sciences for $500 Million Joby Aviation has agreed to acquire defense tech firm Resonant Sciences for $500 million to expand its government revenue\. Shares of the pre-profit eVTOL developer fell 4-6% as investors reacted to the significant cash outlay\. Joby Aviation, a U\.S\.-based developer of electric vertical take-off and landing \(eVTOL\) aircraft, has announced a definitive agreement to purchase defense technology firm Resonant Sciences for approximately $500 million\. The transaction is structured as a mix of $450 million in cash and $50 million in Joby common stock, with a projected closing date in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals\. Following the announcement, shares of Joby Aviation \(NYSE: JOBY\) declined by 4% to 6\.5%\. Investors appear to be weighing the strategic benefits against the immediate use of a large cash reserve, particularly as the company is currently in a capital-intensive phase and has not yet reached commercial profitability\.
